system.description:
Something about this character makes their forks diverge from their core personality more quickly than usual. When attempting a merge, treat the fork’s time apart as if it were one step lower on the Merging table (p. 275, EP). For example, a fork that is absent under an hour is treated as if it were away for 1–4 hours. Characters with this trait may not take the multitasking implant; the continual forking and merging is too stressful on their mind.

Source: Eclipse Phase Transhuman, p. 88.
